full: The sudden explosion caused the crowded square to scatter immediately, with people running in all directions to escape the potential danger and debris.

stem: Desperate to join the army, she ________ herself as a bearded young man by cutting her hair so she could fight on the battlefield.
trans: 渴望参军，她剪掉头发伪装成一位长胡子的年轻人，以便能在战场上战斗。
full: Desperate to join the army, she disguised herself as a bearded young man by cutting her hair so she could fight on the battlefield.

stem: Many economists predict that the country will face a severe economic _______ next year as manufacturing output declines and unemployment rates continue to rise steadily.
trans: 许多经济学家预测，随着制造业产出下降和失业率持续上升，该国明年将面临严重的经济衰退。
full: Many economists predict that the country will face a severe economic recession next year as manufacturing output declines and unemployment rates continue to rise steadily.

stem: The two countries have decided to _______ diplomatic talks next month after a six-month suspension caused by the ongoing border dispute between neighbors.
trans: 两邻国已决定在下个月恢复因持续边境争端而中断了六个月的外交谈判。
full: The two countries have decided to resume diplomatic talks next month after a six-month suspension caused by the ongoing border dispute between neighbors.

stem: Parents who adopt a highly _______ approach to child-rearing often allow their children unlimited freedom without setting clear behavioral boundaries or strict rules.
trans: 采取高度宽容育儿方式的父母通常允许孩子无限自由，而不设定明确的行为界限或严格规则。
full: Parents who adopt a highly permissive approach to child-rearing often allow their children unlimited freedom without setting clear behavioral boundaries or strict rules.

stem: The new apartment building offers _______ living spaces designed for young professionals who prefer efficiency and convenience over excessive square footage in cities.
trans: 新公寓楼提供紧凑型生活空间，专为偏好效率和便利而非超大面积的年轻城市专业人士设计。
full: The new apartment building offers compact living spaces designed for young professionals who prefer efficiency and convenience over excessive square footage in cities.

stem: The environmental group launched a public awareness _______ to encourage local citizens to reduce plastic waste and protect fragile ocean ecosystems.
trans: 环保组织发起了一场公众意识运动，鼓励当地市民减少塑料垃圾并保护脆弱的海洋生态系统。
full: The environmental group launched a public awareness campaign to encourage local citizens to reduce plastic waste and protect fragile ocean ecosystems.

stem: The central government plans to _______ new environmental regulations next week that will strictly control industrial emissions and promote sustainable development in manufacturing sectors.
trans: 中央政府计划下周发布新的环保法规，严格管控工业排放并促进制造业可持续发展。
full: The central government plans to issue new environmental regulations next week that will strictly control industrial emissions and promote sustainable development in manufacturing sectors.

stem: Advanced municipal water purification systems can effectively _______ out harmful contaminants and bacteria before the treated water finally reaches household taps.
trans: 先进的市政水净化系统可以有效过滤掉有害污染物和细菌，使处理后的水最终到达家庭水龙头。
full: Advanced municipal water purification systems can effectively filter out harmful contaminants and bacteria before the treated water finally reaches household taps.

stem: The _______ reason for the project failure was poor communication between team members rather than any lack of technical expertise or financial resources.
trans: 项目失败的主要原因是团队成员之间的沟通不畅，而非技术专长或财务资源的缺乏。
full: The principal reason for the project failure was poor communication between team members rather than any lack of technical expertise or financial resources.

stem: The local authority decided to _______ a heavy tax on luxury goods to increase public revenue and reduce growing social inequality in the region.
trans: 地方当局决定对奢侈品征收重税，以增加公共收入并减少该地区日益加剧的社会不平等。
full: The local authority decided to impose a heavy tax on luxury goods to increase public revenue and reduce growing social inequality in the region.

stem: The professor asked students to choose a specific historical event that would _______ the complex relationship between rapid economic development and long-term environmental protection.
trans: 教授要求学生选择一个特定的历史事件来例证经济快速发展与长期环境保护之间的复杂关系。
full: The professor asked students to choose a specific historical event that would exemplify the complex relationship between rapid economic development and long-term environmental protection.

stem: Many young professionals today still have the _______ that career success comes easily without years of hard work and persistent effort in competitive fields.
trans: 如今许多年轻专业人士仍然抱有错觉，认为在竞争激烈的领域中不经过多年努力就能轻易获得事业成功。
full: Many young professionals today still have the illusion that career success comes easily without years of hard work and persistent effort in competitive fields.

stem: The doctor prescribed a traditional herbal medicine as an effective _______ for the patient's chronic insomnia and related anxiety disorders affecting daily life.
trans: 医生开了一种传统草药作为有效疗法来治疗患者影响日常生活的慢性失眠和相关焦虑障碍。
full: The doctor prescribed a traditional herbal medicine as an effective remedy for the patient's chronic insomnia and related anxiety disorders affecting daily life.

stem: After working for the company for ten years, every employee _______ receive a full pension upon retirement according to the new labor contract agreement signed last month.
trans: 根据上个月签署的新劳动合同协议，每位在公司工作满十年的员工都有权在退休时领取全额养老金。
full: After working for the company for ten years, every employee is entitled to receive a full pension upon retirement according to the new labor contract agreement signed last month.

stem: Despite numerous unexpected challenges and external pressures, the research team managed to _______ and complete the project before the strict deadline imposed by the funding agency.
trans: 尽管面临无数意想不到的挑战和外部压力，研究团队仍设法保持正轨并在资助机构规定的严格截止日期前完成了项目。
full: Despite numerous unexpected challenges and external pressures, the research team managed to stay on track and complete the project before the strict deadline imposed by the funding agency.

stem: The lecture was so dense with technical information that many students found it difficult to _______ all the complex theories presented by the professor in a single session.
trans: 讲座的技术信息非常密集，许多学生发现很难在一节课中吸收教授呈现的所有复杂理论。
full: The lecture was so dense with technical information that many students found it difficult to take in all the complex theories presented by the professor in a single session.
